user.title: Reauth Link for Spotify
user.description: Spotify sign-ins expire after 6 months. This integration sends the account owner a link, and they renew it on their own phone, without opening Home Assistant. Set up Spotify or SpotifyPlus before this one.

data.url: Public https address of this Home Assistant

data_description.url: Where Spotify sends the owner back after they approve, so their phone must be able to open it. Your own domain or Home Assistant Cloud (Nabu Casa) both work. Plain http does not: Spotify only accepts https.
data_description.time: When something is due, the notice goes out at this time of the day.

login.title: Login to renew
login.description:
First, add this address to the Redirect URIs of your app in the Spotify developer dashboard, and keep the one already there:

`{redirect_uri}`

data_description.login: Only logins of Spotify and SpotifyPlus that are already set up.
data_description.owner: Actions, not entities: notify.mobile_app_ followed by the name of the owner's phone. The Home Assistant app creates that action by itself when the owner signs in to this Home Assistant on that phone, so there is nothing to set up. The owner gets the link 30 days before the sign-in expires, and again every 7 days until it is renewed. With no owner here, nobody is sent the link: the administrator is told when it is time, and sends it on with the Generate links action.
data_description.admin: The same kind of action, for the phone of whoever looks after this Home Assistant. Told when it is renewed, when 7 days are left and the owner has not renewed it, and when the link cannot be created or sent. It can only be left empty if there is an owner.
data_description.days: Spotify gives 6 months. 180 is a little under that, on purpose.

reconfigure.title: Reauth Link for Spotify
reconfigure.description:
If you change the address, add the new one to the Redirect URIs of your app in the Spotify developer dashboard. Links already sent stop working. The address registered now is:

`{redirect_uri}`

error.invalid_url: Use https followed by a name the phone can reach from outside, not an IP address or a .local name.
error.not_https: Spotify only accepts https, because the sign-in travels through this address. Use your own domain with https or Home Assistant Cloud (Nabu Casa).
error.my_missing: The My Home Assistant integration is not loaded, and without it Home Assistant cannot build the {integration} link. Add `my:` (or `default_config:`) to configuration.yaml and restart.
error.missing_credentials: The application credentials of {integration} are missing or unavailable. Add the Client ID and the Client Secret again in Settings, Devices & services, Application credentials.
error.pkce: {integration} signs in with PKCE, where the secret is created and lost together with the window of Home Assistant that started it. A link cannot renew this kind of sign-in.
error.unsupported: {integration} does not sign in through a plain authorization page, so a link cannot renew it.
error.flow_failed: The reauthentication of {integration} failed inside Home Assistant ({error}). Update Home Assistant to {min_version} or newer, update {integration} and try again.
error.flow_aborted: {integration} refused the reauthentication ({reason}). Update Home Assistant to {min_version} or newer, check {integration} and try again.
error.login_gone: This login is no longer in Home Assistant.
error.no_account: {integration} does not say which account this login belongs to, so Home Assistant would refuse the renewal as another account.
error.invalid_notify: This action does not exist in this Home Assistant. Choose one from the list, such as notify.mobile_app_my_phone (an entity does not work here).
error.nobody: Choose who gets the notices: the owner, the administrator, or both.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already set up. Use “Add login” there for another account.

expiring.title: Login expires on {date}: {integration} ({account})
expiring.description:
The owner of the account `{account}` has not renewed it, and it expires on {date}. The Send link button of this login sends the link again, and the Generate links action returns it, to send through any chat.

If it was renewed on the Home Assistant screen, ignore this item: a renewal made there is not noticed.

expired.title: Login may have expired on {date}: {integration} ({account})
expired.description:
The owner of the account `{account}` has not renewed it, and it may have expired on {date}. The date is an estimate, by the last sign-in this integration knows of. The Send link button of this login sends the link again, and the Generate links action returns it, to send through any chat.

If it was renewed on the Home Assistant screen, ignore this item: a renewal made there is not noticed.

rejected.title: Renewal refused: {integration} ({account})
rejected.description: The owner of the account `{account}` approved, but {integration} asks to sign in again, as when a permission is missing. The owner needs a new link, and has to approve everything it asks for. If an owner was chosen, it goes out with the next notices, or now with the Send link button of this login. The Generate links action returns it, to send through any chat.

not_back.title: Not back since the renewal: {integration} ({account})
not_back.description: The owner of the account `{account}` approved more than a day ago, and {integration} has not loaded since. Check it in Settings, Devices & services. If a permission is missing, the owner needs a new link: the Send link button of this login sends it, and the Generate links action returns it.

unlisted.title: Not in Reauth Link: {integration} ({account})
unlisted.description: The account `{account}` is in this Home Assistant, but nobody will be told before its sign-in expires. Add it in Settings, Devices & services, Reauth Link, Add login. If it should not be renewed by link, or cannot be added, ignore this item.

generate_link.name: Generate links
generate_link.description: Returns the renewal link of each login, to send by another channel (administrators only).
